Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
There’s something special in the air at dawn, when the rising sun shines morning light across Secret Lair’s glistening foil fields and the cards awaken with a soft glow. This bundle celebrates that feeling with a shimmering bouquet that includes all the foil cards from Spring Superdrop 2024.
Contents:
• 1x Secret Lair x Hatsune Miku: Sakura Superstar EN Foil Edition
• 1x Secret Lair x Hatsune Miku: Sakura Superstar JP Foil Edition
• 1x sAnS mERcY Foil Edition
• 1x Goblingram Foil Edition
• 1x Poker Faces Foil Edition
• 1x Outlaw Anthology Vol. 1: Rebellious Renegades Foil Edition
• 1x Outlaw Anthology Vol. 2: Sinister Scoundrels Foil Edition
• 1x Showcase: Outlaws of Thunder Junction Foil Edition
